observations: A large industrial machine in a wooden crate, wrapped partially in plastic.
The machine has a stainless steel or metal exterior with two large white doors on the left and a control panel on the right.
The brand 'DINGLI' is visible in blue and red letters on the control panel in all three photos.
The control panel has a small digital display and multiple green and red buttons and indicators.
The machine appears to be new or unused, as it is still in packaging and shows no signs of wear.
The photos are taken in a warehouse or storage area with wooden crates and dim lighting.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JUJ' and 'ENSURE MACHINES' is overlaid on all photos.

Photos of the interior of the machine with doors open.

response.reason: The brand and model are confirmed, but the capacity claim cannot be verified from the photos. The machine's functionality and completeness are also unproven, which affects pricing. Proof of operation and specifications is needed before pricing.
